grain: one row per opportunity created inside the simulation window; lifecycle lives on the row - terminal rows carry close_date + won/lost stage, open rows carry an open stage, null close_date and a revised expected_close_date

columns.name: opportunity_id
columns.semantics: OPP-nnnnn globally sequential primary key

columns.name: account_id
columns.semantics: -> accounts.account_id

columns.name: owner
columns.semantics: rep name pool; respects ownership history when present

columns.name: region
columns.semantics: denormalized from account

columns.name: segment
columns.semantics: denormalized from account

columns.name: icp
columns.semantics: denormalized from account

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.semantics: FY26-Qn label from the configured calendar

columns.name: created_date
columns.semantics: close date minus duration draw

columns.name: close_date
columns.semantics: within quarter; NULL while the deal is open

columns.name: expected_close_date
columns.semantics: pipeline block; inserted adjacent to close_date; slips past quarter-end per slip-rate knobs

columns.name: stage
columns.semantics: ONE canonical lifecycle field: Closed Won / Closed Lost terminal; open stages come from pipeline block config

columns.name: list_price
columns.semantics: lognormal median/sigma knobs; whale multiplier applied to outliers

columns.name: discount_pct
columns.semantics: effect-driven curve (group x period base, pricing_response elasticity modifiers, end-of-quarter boost, noise)

columns.name: realized_price
columns.semantics: DERIVED: list_price x (1 - discount_pct/100); never sampled independently

columns.name: territory
columns.semantics: emitted before product columns

columns.name: product_id
columns.semantics: products block attribution trio

columns.name: product_tier
columns.semantics: tier label driving price/tier analyses

columns.name: cogs_ratio
columns.semantics: cost-of-goods ratio enabling margin math

columns.name: is_outlier
columns.semantics: persistent replay of the whale selection stream

columns.name: motion
columns.semantics: derived chronologically: first deal per account = New Logo, later = Expansion

columns.name: in_commit
columns.semantics: share of WON deals flagged as org commit; optional bias toward zero-touch accounts

derived.enforcement: generation-time compute; independent sampling is a sanity violation

notes: Column order matters: insertion order defines workbook sheet columns.
